positions.as_written: Count the bow ties here too, but expect more of them than on the medial side, because the meniscus is wider relative to its plateau and more nearly circular.
Learn the four pitfalls and trace each structure to its other end before calling a tear.
Expect more bow tie slices than on the medial side, because the meniscus is nearly circular.
Before lateral meniscal surgery, assess shape, root integrity and the posterolateral periphery, and plan to test mobility whatever the imaging says.
In discoid meniscus, expect the peripheral attachment to be abnormal more often than imaging suggests, and plan stabilisation as a possibility rather than a surprise.
